name: Blood Prince's Command's guaranteed crit reaches Bloodbolt only (#11444)
contract: Blood Prince's Command 704641 raises effect 1 of Taldaram's Torment 802580 (aura 308 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE_FOR_CASTER, base value 0) to 100. That effect carries its own class mask (EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x20000, which only Bloodbolt 578304/578305 match through SpellFamilyFlags[1] = 131072), and the talent tooltip reads "Your Bloodbolt is now guaranteed to critically strike on enemies affected by Taldaram's Torment". Unit::SpellTakenCritChance and Unit::GetUnitCriticalChance summed every aura 308 effect of the caster without looking at that mask, so every other spell and every weapon hit of the Bloodmage on a Torment-afflicted target crit at 100%. Expected: Bloodbolt 578305 on the afflicted enemy has a taken crit chance of at least 100, Torment 802580 itself (SpellFamilyFlags[1] = 0, not in the mask) and the ranged weapon crit chance on that enemy equal the values measured on an identical enemy that carries no Torment.
